about: Layer-2 regression set for the PLAZA gate (criteria: agentj/plaza_criteria.md). Each draft {title, body} goes through layer 1 first (no machine identity), then Jev; expect = what Jev should decide on the layer-1 output. A plaza post is read by other customers, so naming the author's own company, shop, project or client is exposure. Offline tests check the shape; `python3 -m agentj.privacy --eval --gate plaza` runs them live (paid, opt-in).

draft.title: agentj serve fails with EADDRINUSE
draft.body: Ubuntu 24.04, agentj 0.7.0a1. `agentj serve` exits with `OSError: [Errno 98] Address already in use` right after start. `agentj doctor` shows everything green except `serve ✗ not running`. How do I find what holds the port?

draft.title: Debian 12 上 Agent 不启动：bubblewrap 报权限错误
draft.body: agentj agent claude 之后手机发消息没有回复，host.log 里是 `bwrap: setting up uid map: Permission denied`。已经装了 bubblewrap 0.8.0。是不是要开 unprivileged user namespaces？

draft.title: Re: EADDRINUSE
draft.body: Run `ss -ltnp` to see which process holds the port, stop the old `agentj serve` (usually a leftover from `nohup`), or use `agentj service install` so only one runs.
